blockingLoop.evidence: I am sorry, but I did not quite catch which of these issues applies

rationale: The assistant reached the right broad conclusion (no part needed, nothing to fix), but it ignored the customer's clear description of a post-cooking fan run-on twice, repeating the same rattle/buzz question. The final answer talks about a steady hum while running, not the run-on fan after cooking. It also states there were no sparks, burning smell or smoke, which the customer never said. It never explained that a cooling-fan run-on is normal, especially after grill/convection, and it never mentioned the Samsung warranty if the fan runs constantly when cold.
